name: Tsuda Kayoko
source:
A transfer student who appears only in [url=/c3106]Ayaka's[/url] route. She transfers in without warning and attaches herself to [url=/c3103]Masaya[/url] and pretends to be his younger sister, calling him "Big Brother".

[spoiler]She is Ritsuko's pen-pal and works as a stage actress.[/spoiler]
